summary.answer: The reset connection is a conditional cross-phase replacement, not an atomic respawn cleanup. It disables offhands and sets a reset flag before a native-use wait; early return or receiver cancellation can bypass its clear/reenable tail. A normal path requests item removal, optionally calls the current loadout pointer, replaces inventory with31 blank slots and dispatches inventory_reset after clearing its flag. It does not join older health/debit/removal threads or directly clear all health readiness fields. Spawn only conditionally initializes missing inventory in its own callback, and the world flag barrier is not a child-thread join. Old captured numeric IDs and object references therefore retain explicit cross-reset identity/scheduling gaps. All claims are bounded recovered-source drafts; original HMH build/settings/native behavior remains unproved.
